chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman, from Jarrah Al-Madainy, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Do not place a ring of gold in your hand.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on wearing a gold ring in the hand according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the prohibition of gold rings for men, a ruling derived from the general prohibition of gold for male adornment in Shia jurisprudence. It reflects the distinct identity markers between genders in Islamic attire, distinguishing men's permissible silver rings from women's gold jewelry. The narration underscores the importance of adhering to specific material restrictions in personal adornment as part of religious observance.
